# Convictus Eesti MTÜ

> > Convictus provides harm reduction services across Estonia, including needle exchange, overdose prevention with naloxone, counseling, and support for people who use drugs.

Convictus operates harm reduction centers in Tallinn (Sitsi, Lastekodu, Plasti), Maardu, Rakvere, and mobile services in Harju, Pärnu, and Tartu counties. The organization offers anonymous, free services including syringe exchange, HIV testing, social and psychological counseling, peer support through the SÜTIK program, and assistance for families and loved ones.

## Key Topics

- Harm reduction (kahjude vähendamine)
- Needle exchange (süstlavahetus)
- Overdose prevention
- Naloxone distribution (naloksoon)
- HIV testing (hiv-testimine)
- Anonymous services
- Social counseling (nõustamine)
- SÜTIK peer support program
- Tallinn, Maardu, Rakvere centers
- Mobile harm reduction bus
- Prison support services
- Women's support groups
- Food and clothing aid
- Safer drug use education

## Harm Reduction Services

- [Ohutu tarvitamine ja üledooside ennetamine (Naloksoon)](https://www.convictus.ee/teenused/ohutu-tarvitamine-ja-uledooside-ennetamine-naloksoon): Safer use and overdose prevention with naloxone distribution
- [Leia abi: Tarvitajale](https://www.convictus.ee/tarvitaja): Help resources for drug users including naloxone and safer use info
- [Psühholoogiline nõustamine](https://www.convictus.ee/teenused/psuhholoogiline-noustamine): Psychological counselling by Inna Farber and Natalja Zaitseva in Tallinn
- [Sotsiaalnõustamine ENG](https://www.convictus.ee/eng/services/sotsiaalnoustamine-eng): Social counselling service in Tallinn, Rakvere, and Maardu
- [Päevakeskus RUS](https://www.convictus.ee/rus/servisy/paevakeskus-rus): Day center services at Lastekodu 6, Tallinn (Russian)
- [Toidu- ja riideabi](https://www.convictus.ee/teenused/toidu-ja-riideabi): Food and clothing aid via Eesti Toidupank at Convictus centres

## Service Locations

- [Sitsi Harm Reduction Centre](https://www.convictus.ee/eng/locations/sitsi): Sitsi 28 harm reduction centre in Tallinn with syringe exchange
- [Maardu Kahjude Vähendamise Keskus](https://www.convictus.ee/keskused/maardu): Maardu harm reduction centre at Kallasmaa 12 since 2012
- [Mobile Harm Reduction Bus](https://www.convictus.ee/eng/locations/mobile-harm-reduction-bus): Mobile harm reduction unit serving Harju, Tallinn, Pärnu, and Tartu

## Support Groups & Peer Programs

- [Tugigrupid ja nõustamine vanglates](https://www.convictus.ee/teenused/tugigrupid-ja-noustamine-vanglates): Prison support groups at Tallinn prison by Konstantin Iru
- [Tugigrupid ja nõustamine vanglates RUS](https://www.convictus.ee/rus/servisy/tugigrupid-ja-noustamine-vanglates-rus): Prison support groups and counselling at Tallinn prison (Russian)
- [Tugigrupp naistele ENG](https://www.convictus.ee/eng/services/tugigrupp-naistele): Women's support group led by Jaana Važajeva (English)
- [SÜTIK RUS](https://www.convictus.ee/rus/programm-sutik): SÜTIK peer support program in Tallinn, Harjumaa, and Rakvere (Russian)

## Resources for Families

- [Seek Help: For Loved Ones](https://www.convictus.ee/eng/for-loved-ones): Family guidance and support resources via narko.ee and tai.ee
- [Lähedane RUS](https://www.convictus.ee/rus/lahedane): Resources for loved ones of drug users (Russian)

## Statistics & Reports

- [Statistics - Convictus Eesti MTÜ](https://www.convictus.ee/eng/statistics): Service statistics and harm reduction metrics for Convictus centres
- [Statistika](https://www.convictus.ee/statistika): Annual statistics for Convictus centres and services
- [Statistika](https://www.convictus.ee/rus/statistika): Service statistics for harm reduction activities (Russian)

## Optional

- [Why Harm Reduction Services Are Needed](https://www.convictus.ee/uudised/why-harm-reduction-services-are-needed): Article on importance of harm reduction services and WHO guidelines
- [Tule vabatahtlikuks liikmeks](https://www.convictus.ee/uudised/tule-vabatahtlikuks-liikmeks): Volunteer recruitment for Convictus harm reduction services
